views.prompt: Full-body character reference for 3D modelling of an 8-year-old girl, half Japanese half Russian: small, dark brown hair in two short braids with red hair ties, bright curious eyes; a yellow hooded raincoat, open, over a striped navy-and-white long-sleeve top, a red pinafore dress, white tights, red rubber boots. Strict T-pose: standing straight, arms stretched out horizontally to the sides at shoulder height, elbows straight, palms facing down, fingers together, feet shoulder width apart, flat on the floor. Neutral calm expression, mouth closed, eyes open. Whole body visible from the top of the hair to the soles of the shoes, centred, nothing cropped. Orthographic-looking views, camera at chest height. Plain light grey seamless studio background, soft even shadowless lighting, no props, no bag, no text, photorealistic, realistic body proportions.
